terms.comment: Lewis & Short: “to seize on the passage before arrival at the destined place, to intercept”.

sources: Lewis & Short: intercipio · Lewis & Short: interceptio
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
